name: gha-trigger-check
description: Will this GitHub Actions workflow run for this push or pull request, and which line of the workflow decides? Branch, tag and path filters, types, [skip ci]. Offline.
long_description: will_workflow_run answers "why didn't my workflow run?" for a push or pull request: branches, branches-ignore, tags, tags-ignore, paths and paths-ignore with GitHub's exact glob rules ("*" stops at "/", "**", "!" exceptions where the last matching pattern wins), pull_request branch filters compared with the base branch, tag pushes ignored when only branch filters exist, default pull_request types, [skip ci] markers, more than 3 tags pushed at once, merge conflicts, and filters that make GitHub reject the file. which_workflows_run checks all workflows of a repository at once. test_filter_patterns tests patterns against branch names or paths. Pattern engine checked against the Go code of nektos/act on 300,000 random cases: 0 differences. Offline, read-only. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).
